items.source_quote:
Script: Have Corina shorten the script
         Slideshow: Have Angela design the slide and match it to the script
         Kahoot/Icebreaker/Mini Discussions: Have Leanna make a 7-10 question kahoot (or find
         one online). Review the icebreakers on the slideshow, and change them how you see fit.
         Add notes for mini discussions: what is the question, and when during the meeting?
         Breakout Rooms (TENTATIVE): Who has never peer tutored and can’t answer
         questions?
         Feedback Form: Have Amanda shorten the feedback form.
         We will do a debrief of the training session after it is over/the next day.
